text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, into the final stretch! Unyielding pride
and boundless dreams now collide upon the turf!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...! Haa...!
—Urgh, gah...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(It's hot, it hurts... it's agonizing――
Trials are always like this!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, that is precisely why!
It fulfills me!
It makes me—truly me!!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I am the Saint, Red Desire――

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: That brilliance—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I will seize it—!!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaahーーー!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: This is the final showdownnn!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: I'm Red Desire!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Repelling a field of fierce rivals, including her nemesis Buena Vista,
Red Desire crosses the finish line in the lead!!
"Saint Red Desire converted all the crushing weight of destiny into pure strength, at last seizing the pinnacle of this world."
"Seeing that divine figure... I had a vision of the future to come."

Across the sea—
That racecourse I have always yearned for.

"Red Desire standing at the very top on
the world-class stage of the 'BC',
just like she did today."

The moment when they treat even the 'BC' stage
as the ultimate trial, conquer it,
and achieve a historic milestone—!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: DESIREEE!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Red Desire,
what an incredible run that was...!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"This is way too crazy...!
Just how much stronger is she gonna get...?!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Desire-chan!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Truly, truly... congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It was a magnificent run,
as if to overwhelm everything in its path...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"I gave it everything I had, but... I was no match for you.
You're amazing."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ufufu... Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
For me as well—
it was the ultimate trial.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You...
You're projecting even more pressure than before, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: No. Licht... a dazzling light.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Desire-chan.
She's gotten... so strong, hasn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming so, so many hardships...
far more than back then.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You have truly grown strong.
You've become an Umamusume who can fire up the Japan Cup... who can fire us all up like this.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Looks like you beat me to it by just a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“Still, just you wait.
I'll catch up and surpass you in no time.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Next race, for sure!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am waiting with all my heart.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, and the time after that, I will conquer it all without fail.
With even greater power than today, time and time again—!"
(Waaaaaahhh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "This view...! All this praise—...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The whole world is united in
celebrating me――...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The world is becoming
filled with "me"――

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: It's overflowing—...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Aah...
So that's how it was...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The 'promised land' I had sought for so long...
was right here."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It is neither a place someone has already aimed for,
nor a place drawn merely in someone's imagination.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "The alternate world where Saint Red Desire can truly shine, that is—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: A world... rewritten by my own hands—...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Through the running of a saintess,
I must expand this world...!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ufufu... I want to pass on soon.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Challenging the 'BC' across the ocean.
Stepping onto the stage of an unseen world—
Red Desire's dramatic victory at the Japan Cup was something that truly changed the world.
—Enough to change the destiny of anyone.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hmm! How long has it been since I last came here?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Still, as expected... this feels the most right.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The turf is where I belong.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Desire, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Seeing you run like that—rewriting all the world's common sense—seriously made me feel like I couldn't just sit around resting."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So—just you wait, Desire.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —I'll catch up right away!
And... my own little world changed too.
Some time after the Japan Cup, an envelope arrived.
"Inside was the ticket to cross the sea that Red Desire had longed for."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Transferring overseas...?

In recognition of Red Desire's stellar performance, a transfer
offer came in from a prominent American team competing worldwide.

"Currently, there were no signs of the 'Crimson Wedge' returning to her body,
and she was steadily getting into peak condition
for her challenge against the world."
Looking ahead—if we are to expand our horizons beyond the "BC" and onto the world stage, we must accept this offer without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...And yet.
You have the face of someone holding back their sorrow..."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me.
What is it that weighs on your mind right now?

She had the gentle, all-seeing face...
of a saint.
One of the conditions of the offer was that she would be assigned a local dedicated trainer over there.

If it's to grant her dream, if I truly care about her,
then sending her off with a smile is the right thing to do. But...
choice_data_list: (I want to walk the path ahead... together with her.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"To the distant Otherworld...
I will not ask you to 'come with me.'"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes,
please send me off with a proper parting gift, okay?
What I needed to do was support Red Desire as a racehorse Umamusume.
She had signed the contract wanting this as well... and we've come this far together.
"Prioritizing my own desires, making her throw away her ticket to the world just so I could say, 'I want to go with you'—there was no way I could say that."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Not once has the path you pointed me toward
ever been wrong."
choice_data_list: Because I was putting what you wanted first.
Because I was putting what you wanted first.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes, precisely.
And... at all times, no matter when.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Because what you and I wished for was the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"My wise resonating soul.
You surely must know by now."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Just what your greed and desires
mean to me."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...While I appreciate the generous offer,
please feel free to decline it.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: And... now, once more, I shall bestow upon you the Saint's blessing.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: A blessing, so that she may believe in herself...

"With warm, merciful palms,
the Saint gently wrapped around those bewildered hands."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: You must be by my side in the 'other world' I am destined to reach.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Because of you, for the very first time—
I truly came to know what it means for my soul to be fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Because I have learned the joy of living in this world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: With a life this fulfilling, it can surely be realized.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Turning the world into the realm I desire.

—Perhaps that had been the way
of the world from the very beginning.

With her by my side,
even distant, boundless ideals
become a certain future we will eventually reach.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Please, let us be together to the ends of the earth.
choice_data_list: ...Ngh, please let me accompany you anywhere, no matter how far!

text_block_list.text: "To the very end of your wish—!"
"‘To the very ends of your wish—!’"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The door to "that place"
has already been opened.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now, shall we go,
Trainer <username>?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
This world awaits the moment
of its complete rebirth—!
